authority.parity_method: Compare a future JITX design graph and generated design data against these requirements; source-text matching is insufficient.

git_commit.subject: Implement native M1 four-key Hall evaluation circuit (#27)

license_boundary.excluded_reason: GPL/QMK-derived 42-key coordinate assets must not be consumed.

board.layout_status: not part of this contract or EDA-002B

net_semantics.VBUS: USB 5 V input; feeds LDO VIN/EN, TPS22919 IN, ESD VBUS, input capacitors, and TP_VBUS.
net_semantics.V3V3: AP2112K output; RP2040 I/O/analog/USB/regulator-input rail, flash rail, logic indicator, decoupling, and TP_3V3.
net_semantics.V1V1: RP2040 internal regulator output and both DVDD pins with decoupling.
net_semantics.HALL_5V: TPS22919 switched output feeding Hall sensors, TMUX1208 VDD, local decoupling, and TP_HALL_5V.
net_semantics.GND: Common circuit return; USB receptacle ground contacts are on this net. USB shell remains a distinct USB_SHIELD net.
net_semantics.USB_SHIELD: Connector shell net; its coupling strategy is intentionally unresolved until layout/G1.
net_semantics.V3V3_and_V1V1_spelling: These source-net identifiers represent schematic 3V3 and 1V1 rails.

data_paths: D+: J_USB.A6/B6 -> U_ESD.IO1_1 -> U_ESD.IO1_2 -> USB_DP_ESD -> R_USB_DP(27 Ohm) -> USB_DP -> U_MCU.USB_DP
D-: J_USB.A7/B7 -> U_ESD.IO2_1 -> U_ESD.IO2_2 -> USB_DM_ESD -> R_USB_DM(27 Ohm) -> USB_DM -> U_MCU.USB_DM

power: VBUS -> U_LDO.VIN and U_LDO.EN; U_LDO.VOUT -> V3V3; U_LDO.GND -> GND
VBUS -> U_LOAD.IN; U_LOAD.OUT -> HALL_5V; U_LOAD.ON -> HALL_PWR_EN; U_LOAD.GND -> GND
qspi_and_bootsel: U_MCU.QSPI_SS -> QSPI_SS_MCU -> R_QSPI_SS(1 kOhm) -> QSPI_SS_FLASH -> U_FLASH.CS and SW_BOOT.pin1
U_FLASH.QSPI_SD0/1/2/3 and QSPI_SCLK connect to matching U_MCU nets
crystal: U_MCU.XIN -> XIN -> Y1.XIN and C_XIN -> GND
Y1.XOUT -> XOUT_XTAL -> C_XOUT -> GND and R_XOUT(1 kOhm) -> XOUT -> U_MCU.XOUT
hall_mux_adc: For each i in 0..3: U_Hi.VCC -> HALL_5V; U_Hi.GND -> GND; U_Hi.OUT -> Hi_RAW -> U_MUX.S(i+1)
U_MUX.A0/A1/A2/EN -> MUX_A0/MUX_A1/MUX_A2/MUX_EN0; U_MUX.VDD -> HALL_5V; U_MUX.GND -> GND
U_MUX.D -> MUX_D -> R_ADC_TOP(6.8 kOhm) -> ADC_SENSE -> U_MCU.ADC_SENSE
ADC_SENSE -> R_ADC_BOTTOM(10 kOhm) -> GND and C_ADC(1 nF) -> GND
test_and_control: U_MCU.RUN, SW_RUN.pin1, and TP_RUN -> RUN; SW_RUN.pin2 -> GND
TP_VBUS, TP_3V3, TP_HALL_5V, TP_H0_RAW..TP_H3_RAW, TP_MUX_D, TP_ADC_SENSE, and TP_GND connect to their identically named measurements

hall_grid.source: Frozen M1 reference and project-owned M1 requirements only.

critical_footprint_geometry.usb_c: TYPE-C-31-M-12: 12 contacts, four plated shell stakes, and two 0.65 mm locating NPTHs; verifier asserts contact and mechanical geometry within 0.001 mm.
critical_footprint_geometry.crystal: ABM8-272-T3: four 1.30 x 1.05 mm pads at 2.30 x 1.75 mm pitch, bottom-view 1/2 over 4/3.
critical_footprint_geometry.flash: W25Q16JVUXIQ USON-8: eight 0.8128 x 0.254 mm signal pads plus 0.254 x 1.651 mm exposed pad; verifier asserts reviewed geometry.

known_design_data_gaps: Supplier part numbers for passives, LEDs, buttons, and test points are unapproved and must not be invented.
USB shield grounding/coupling strategy is deferred to layout/G1.
This contract does not authorize placement, routing, or generated manufacturing output.
